summary_en: The company will cancel 740,000 treasury shares on October 22, 2026, reducing issued shares by 3.7%. Post-cancellation issued share count will be 19,013,800 shares.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On October 6, 2026, the company's Board of Directors resolved to cancel 740,000 treasury shares in accordance with the company's basic policy on the holding and cancellation of treasury shares, as provided under Article 178 of the Companies Act. The cancellation is scheduled to be effective on October 22, 2026. The cancelled shares represent 3.7% of issued shares prior to cancellation. Following the cancellation, the company's total issued shares will be 19,013,800 shares.
